lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry. Excuse me. We had this cart.
Yeah, well, I had a 24-inch waist. You lose things.
Now, come on. Get out of my way.
Oh, I'm sorry. You know, maybe I wasn't being clear.
Hey, hey, hey! There weren't any clothes in it!
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Quit making up rules!
Let go! Come on, this is my cart! You know I thought it was mine!
All right, listen, Mitzi, if you want this cart,
you're gonna have to take me with it!
A brand new woman, ladies and gentlemen.
Thank you, thank you. I could not have done this without you.
Okay, um, uh, more clothes in the dryer?
